comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 5d573b7, the only commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.1. Params 2, 18, 19, 20, 21 and 22 are configured but no ParamWidget is added for them: they are sliders on the BARK knob's menu (Modulation depth), the FILT knob's menu (Mod depth, Keytrack) and the module's own menu (Velocity curve, Reed drive, Mod depth), so no click on the panel can reach them and they carry no line or tag here. The manual is dated to 2.0.0 and disagrees with the shipped code in two places: it gives the VOLUME default as 70% where configParam sets 0.85, and it calls the reed drive's mod depth bipolar where configParam gives it 0 to 1. MOD is scaled two different ways by the two things that read it — times 0.2 and clamped to ±1 for bark, times 0.1 and clamped to 0 and 1 for reed drive, so a negative voltage swings the bark and is ignored by the reed drive; the manual gives only the ±5V to ±1 mapping. The gate and pedal Schmitt triggers are only advanced on every eighth sample, so a gate shorter than about 170 microseconds at 48kHz can be missed.
